selection_policy: Selected means the preferred raw return within the two-attempt limit, not certification that every strict requirement passed.
validation_method: Visual review of every returned image plus native PNG dimensions, alpha, SHA256 and byte-for-byte copy verification. Normalized mask IoU compares alpha >= 128 against guide coordinates mapped to output dimensions in memory only; no image files were resized or edited.
limitations: All tool returns are 1254 x 1254 rather than requested 1024 x 1024; preserved unresized as instructed.
Exact guide silhouettes were not achieved. Normalized mask overlaps are recorded, but do not certify internal part-edge registration.
RGBA transparency is present, but raw returns retain some stray nonzero alpha outside the expected silhouette.
Corrective passes reduce baked lighting; residual face shading remains, especially on the front/back metal. The strict shadowless albedo requirement is not fully met.
One corrective generation was used per view. No further generation, postprocessing, model edits, builds or runtime integration were performed.
